summary:
The iPad 6th gen (2018) ended up in more school bags than any other model, so it's seen its share of sticky fingers and dropped-desk moments.

Glass-only repair is available on this model, which usually costs less than a whole new display. A worn battery costs R850 to replace, and a faulty Lightning port is repaired with micro-soldering for typically R900 to R1,200, keeping your data in place. We fix failed Home buttons too.

Every repair starts with a free diagnostic at our workshop in Silvercrest Shopping Centre, Silvamonte, uses OEM-spec parts, and carries a 6-month warranty.

Tap Learn more for iPad 6th gen prices.
